title: 💠 Two violating oil tankers were stopped in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz
text:
💠 Two violating oil tankers were stopped in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz"

"**Public Relations of the IRGC Navy:**"

"🔹 Two violating oil tankers — one in the eastern area and the other in the western area of the Strait of Hormuz — which intended to pass through an unauthorized route, were involved in an incident and were stopped in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz."

"🔹 These two tankers turned off all their navigation and positioning systems and, with the support of the terrorist American military, attempted to exit the Strait of Hormuz through an unauthorized route."

"🔹 After several radio warnings were ignored by these two tankers, they entered an unsafe area, were involved in an incident, and were stopped near the southern coast of the Strait of Hormuz."

"🔹 The stopping and fire aboard the violating vessels are the result of the mischief of the terrorist American military and of disregarding and ignoring Iranian regulations in the Strait of Hormuz."
